journal_lines: Kicked something that rang. A geode. Small but real.
Hollow stone underfoot. Broke it open. Violet inside.
The cave had crystals in it. Broke some free.
Tripped on a stone the size of a fist. It rolled, and it rang.
Inside, the small geode was a small world that had decided to be purple.
Did not need a pickaxe. Did need patience. Cracked it with care.
Crystals like small frozen flames. Carried them carefully.
Found it in a streambed. The water had been working on the outside for years. I worked on the inside in minutes.
